name: View the approved DROP 001 storefront
description: Verifies the rebuilt storefront presents the campaign and complete locked DROP 001 collection.
steps: Scroll from the campaign hero to DROP 001
Confirm the master product visual and all six locked design names are visible
expected: The campaign renders without an error state and ORIGINAL BALI CORE, MORE THAN PARADISE, ISLAND AFTER DARK, SOUTH COAST, ISLAND SPIRIT, and ORIGINAL PEOPLE are all visible.

name: Use the rebuilt storefront on mobile
description: Verifies the storefront remains contained and readable at phone width while preserving the master product visual.
steps: Scroll through DROP 001 and the six product cards
Continue through Product Line and Packaging
expected: The page content stays within the phone viewport, the six product cards are readable, and the packaging section renders without broken imagery.

name: Navigate through story and First Access
description: Verifies the main storefront navigation reaches customer-facing sections without exposing internal guideline content as page sections.
steps: Use the STORY navigation link and read the brand story section
Use the PRODUCT LINE navigation link and confirm the five product-line categories
Use the FIRST ACCESS navigation link
expected: Story, Product Line, and First Access sections are reachable and contain customer-facing storefront content.
